title: pass owner (package.json team) in core-shell, billing, reports

summary: validateApp now throws if owner is missing/empty; core-shell (platform), billing (payments), reports (insights) pass owner matching package.json team. Assumptions: owner hardcoded as literals (bundler inlines, no JSON import); whitespace-only owner counts as empty. Single PR #1 in mono since shared-contracts is inlined; local builds of all 3 apps passed, CI and CD green.
